author: De'Andrew Harris
description: The Open World — desktop app (Electron) for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Bundles the full PC game client; accounts, saves, and PC multiplayer run on the hosted backend. Native (electron-updater) + bundled-version update channels.
name: @the-open-world/desktop

scripts.package: npm run build:client && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:client && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:client && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.package:win: npm run build:client && npm run build && electron-builder --win
